_why: What a drum module's pads play when the module itself says nothing movy can read: no declared names or roles, and no per-pad param whose value names the drum. Read by src/ai/pad-labels.ts only as the LAST word before guessing; anything the module declares or holds wins. Each entry is a stand-in for an upstream declaration (child_roles / child_names, or enum options on the per-pad param) and should go once the module ships one.

krautdrums._source: krautdrums-move src/dsp/krautdrums.c VOICES[]: sixteen fixed voices, one per pad in order

strut._source: strut-move src/dsp/dice.c ROLES[]: every factory and rolled kit keeps this layout; a pad's SOUND reads 'Own' after a kit load

weird-dreams._source: weird-dreams-move src/dsp/weird_dreams.c PRESET_NAMES[]: v<N>_preset reads back as an index the module declares as a bare int
